d:
We’re celebrating 10 years of Essentials this year! Four compilations a year for over a decade is a lot, so what better way to celebrate than dropping another “Best of” mix now that Essentials Summer 2026 is out (give it a spin if you haven’t yet)! This mix is as uplifting as it gets; two hours of non-stop fun with some of the best lofi, jazzy and upbeat summer tracks from the past decade. We hope you enjoy.
